\section{Overview}
The sharp discrete hypercontractive radius and the associated norm-comparison constant are explicit scalar functions of the minimum atom mass.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Sharp discrete hypercontractive radius]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.sharpDiscreteRadius}
\leanok
For $q,\lambda\in\bbr$, set $u=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$ and define $\rho(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(u/q)/\sinh(u/(q/(q-1)))}$, where division by zero is zero, $\log 0=0$, $\log x=\log|x|$ for $x<0$, and $\sqrt x=0$ for $x\le0$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Finite-product norm comparison constant]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.productNormComparisonConstant}
\leanok
For $\lambda\in\bbr$, define $C(\lambda)=e$ if $\lambda=1/2$, and $C(\lambda)=((1-\lambda)/\lambda)^{1/(2(1-2\lambda))}$ otherwise, where division by zero is zero; for $x<0$, $x^r=|x|^r\cos(\pi r)$; and $0^r=0$ for $r\ne0$, while $0^0=1$.
\end{definition}
